title: Fix Puzzle3d Side Panel Hide
description: When hiding an object in puzzle3d side panel document, the 3d object stays visible. Root cause: ObjectStore.syncAppearanceFromFixture ignores hidden/locked flags; document panel cache not invalidated on appearance-only fixture patches.
summary:
Fixed puzzle3d hide/show from the document side panel not affecting the 3d viewport.

Root cause: `ObjectStore.syncAppearanceFromFixture` compared mesh/kind/vortex fields but ignored `hidden` and `locked`, so appearance-only fixture patches (which do not bump structure revision) never updated object records. Attractions were also not refreshed on appearance sync.

Fixes:
- Compare and apply `hidden`/`locked` on objects; replace records wholesale so un-hide clears stale flags.
- Sync `fixture.attractions` when appearance changes.
- Invalidate document panel section cache in `patchFixture` when appearance fingerprint changes so eye icons and `isHidden` rows update without a structure revision bump.

Tests: new vitest coverage in `@semio-tech/puzzle-3d-react` and `@semio-tech/puzzle-3d-play` (75 play tests, 348 react tests pass).
